metadata.title: Schnakenberg (1979) Tri-Molecular Limit-Cycle Reaction-Diffusion, Turing-Hopf Codimension-2 Bifurcation & Dictyostelium discoideum Morphogenesis Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Schnakenberg J (1979). Simple chemical reaction systems with limit cycle behaviour. Journal of Theoretical Biology 81(3):389-400.
Turing AM (1952). The chemical basis of morphogenesis. Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London B 237(641):37-72.
Goldbeter A (1975). Mechanism for oscillatory synthesis of cyclic AMP in Dictyostelium discoideum. Nature 253(5492):540-542.
Grace M, Hütt MT (2015). Regulation of spatiotemporal patterns by biological variability: general principles and applications to Dictyostelium discoideum. PLoS Computational Biology 11(11):e1004367.

specimen.species: Dictyostelium discoideum (cellular slime mold fruiting body sorocarps & aggregation mounds on agar)

schnakenberg_1979_governing_equations.reaction_network: X <-> A (rates k_1, k_{-1}), B -> Y (rate k_2), 2X + Y -> 3X (cubic autocatalysis, rate k_3)

dimensionless_pde.u_eq: du/dt = gamma * (a - u + u^2 * v) + Lap(u)
dimensionless_pde.v_eq: dv/dt = gamma * (b - u^2 * v) + d * Lap(v)

bifurcation_boundaries.limit_cycle_condition: b - a > (a + b)^3   (unstable focus/node inside Poincare-Bendixson trapping region)
bifurcation_boundaries.critical_wavenumber_det_min: k_det_min^2 = gamma * (d * (b - a) / (a + b) - (a + b)^2) / (2 * d)

canonical_regimes.label: Supercritical Turing Hexagonal Spots
canonical_regimes.expected_behavior: Stationary hexagonal spot array of high-u / depleted-v aggregation centers

canonical_regimes.label: High-Diffusivity Turing Stripes & Spots
canonical_regimes.expected_behavior: High-amplitude stationary Turing peaks and short labyrinthine ridges

canonical_regimes.label: Turing-Hopf Codimension-2 Coexistence
canonical_regimes.expected_behavior: Both Hopf (tr(J_0) > 0) and Turing (d > d_c) modes unstable; spatiotemporal breathing/oscillating spots

canonical_regimes.label: Schnakenberg Limit-Cycle Relaxation Oscillator
canonical_regimes.expected_behavior: Globally attracting autonomous limit cycle (b - a = 0.45 > (a+b)^3 = 0.1664) modeling glycolytic/cAMP pulsatile oscillations

canonical_regimes.label: Equal-Diffusion Negative Control (d = 1)
canonical_regimes.expected_behavior: All Fourier modes decay exponentially (Re sigma(k^2) <= -18.0 < 0); spatial perturbations vanish to homogeneous (u_*, v_*)
